name: Lemonade Remixed
game: Lemonade Tycoon Deluxe (Windows, 2002) in a native Mac app with the original game running unchanged in a bundled Wine

inputs.description: Your own Lemonade Tycoon Deluxe installer (Setup.exe, the Zone.com edition) and its registration name and key, chosen in the app after installation. The build does not read it.

tools.name: /usr/bin/arch
tools.label: Rosetta 2
tools.note: Install Rosetta 2, which runs Wine on Apple Silicon: softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license

publication.reason: The app is built on the player's Mac and contains no game files; players install the game from their own Setup.exe. Releases publish the recipe only.
